purpose: Analytically eliminate the entire 2^(3m) edge zero/free layer of the v8.5.3 GF(3) rank-state sum for each fixed local transition assignment, leaving an exact 3^m sum of characteristic-polynomial/full-support-code evaluations.

setup.closed_network: m canonical six-port quotient wires with E=3m physical NEQ splice edges
setup.local_state: tau_v in {0,+,-} with weights w(0)=-2 and w(+)=w(-)=3
setup.A_tau: The GF(3) row matrix whose rows are all wire current-conservation equations plus VP or VM at each wire selected by nonzero tau_v. Columns are the E oriented splice currents in their actual Hamiltonian exposed-port incidence order.
setup.M_tau: The GF(3)-representable column matroid of A_tau.

edge_subset_elimination.v8_5_3_inner_sum: For fixed tau, sum over zero-edge subsets S subseteq E of (-1)^(E-|S|) * 3^|S| * 3^(E-rank([A_tau; I_S])).
edge_subset_elimination.rank_lemma: Writing U=E\S, rank([A_tau; I_S]) = |S| + rank((A_tau)_U). This follows by quotienting the row space by the selected coordinate rows I_S; only the restriction of A_tau to unselected columns U remains.
edge_subset_elimination.characteristic_identity: For the column matroid M_tau, chi_M_tau(3)=sum_{U subseteq E} (-1)^|U| * 3^(r(M_tau)-r(U)). Therefore the complete edge layer equals 3^(E-r(M_tau))*chi_M_tau(3).

full_support_code_interpretation.statement: For a full-row-rank representation of A_tau, chi_M_tau(3) equals the number of row-space codewords whose every edge coordinate is nonzero.
full_support_code_interpretation.significance: The residual hard object is now an exact full-support ternary linear-code count tied to the actual Hamiltonian port incidence, not a generic transition-matroid isomorphism invariant.

exact_two_wire_control.method: For every permutation joining the six exposed ports of two quotient wires, compare direct enumeration over 12^2 wire states with the characteristic-collapse identity. For every one of the nine local tau choices independently verify chi_M_tau(3) by both the subset-rank definition and enumeration of full-support GF(3) row-space codewords.

anti_loop.v6_8_transition_matroid: Not a loop. v6.8 kills carriers depending only on full-transition-matroid isomorphism. A_tau keeps actual Hamiltonian port incidence and ordered VP/VM rows, data explicitly outside that invariant.
anti_loop.v1_9_linear_hash: Not a loophole around v1.9. The v1.9 barrier forbids dimension-reducing linear zero hashing as an exact feasibility oracle. Here chi_M_tau(3) preserves the exact full-support row-space set/count; replacing it by a lower-dimensional hash or span relaxation would again require a new soundness proof and is not assumed.
anti_loop.generic_hardness_warning: An exact characteristic-polynomial identity is not itself an efficient algorithm. Neither generic chi_M(3) evaluation nor the outer 3^m local-state sum is asserted polynomial time.

gained: The entire explicit 2^(3m) edge zero/free state layer is removed algebraically.
The visible state sum contracts from 24^m rank terms to 3^m Hamiltonian-order-sensitive ternary matroid terms.
Each residual matroid term has a second exact interpretation as a full-support row-space codeword count, giving a concrete object for the next compression attack.
not_gained: No polynomial-time evaluator for the family M_tau.
No polynomial compression of the remaining 3^m local transition assignments.
No witness-reconstruction procedure from a compressed aggregate.

next_target.name: E8_C4_GF3_COHOMOLOGY_LOCAL_TRANSITION_COMPRESSION_V8_5_5
next_target.directive: Quotient the selected VP/VM rows by the conservation/cut-space rows and exploit the special Hamiltonian six-port incidence. Determine whether all 3^m local choices can be aggregated through a polynomial number of cohomology or residual-row-space signatures while retaining exact full-support counts. If the number of exact signatures grows exponentially on an explicit smooth-C4 source family, freeze that as the next scoped barrier instead of hiding it inside a transfer table.
mandatory_gates: control against v6.8 balanced-mutation invariance and v1.9 lossy linear hashing
